Hello, I'm a wizard.
Usually I post Christmas pictures and stuff, but this year I've been working on this one for longer, so unfortunately I haven't had much time.
So don't worry. The wizard was just a regular Kuri this year. Kusou.

So, I started this work thinking that it would be seasonal again, or that the Year of the Rabbit would end and I would finish writing the reverse bunny girl story... but if I had been working on it slowly, it would have taken me almost until the new year.
Well, if that happens, then it will happen, and I could just publish it as a New Year's painting... but that's just how rabbits are the main characters, so I ended up posting it at the end of the year.

Well, the story is a bit complicated, as it pretends to be about a dragon man doing a rabbit girl, in reference to the change in the zodiac sign... but in fact the rabbit girl is more scheming...
It seems that the world is structured in such a way that when the zodiac sign changes, the race in question is strengthened, and even if the Usa are strengthened a little, they can only seduce men and make them pay tribute, but when it comes to a powerful race like the Tatsugami, It seems like it will be almost impossible to handle while Etogami is protecting you.
And since the target usually turns to the next zodiac sign, the Migo, they have developed heretical techniques to try to do something about it, and have finally fallen prey to the taboo of inter-species fusion.
What caught my eye about the weak Usa was that they currently had protection, and that it was easy to let the Tatsugami off guard and trap them... and, as I mention in the story, there may have been some kind of sympathy between the downtrodden races.
By the way, the initiative between the fused races is a mystery... Well, although the Usa's personality usually comes out, even in that state their intelligence and thought forms are already quite close to those of the Migo, so it may actually be that the Migo are holding the reins.

There's a lot of room for consideration around here, but..Since the main focus is not on the somewhat complicated story, I would like you to love her as just a tentacle reverse bunny with green skin, an evil, assimilating, absorbing rabbit dragon monster girl. Too many attributes!

Have a great New Year everyone! And I look forward to seeing you again next year.
